name: Lok's Skull
summary: In the southern Barrens, Lok's Skull marks the fall of a feared Razormane leader. Lok Orcbane led fierce quilboar raids against Horde supply routes, and the skull is his severed head.

sections.title: A Chieftain's Fall
sections.body: Lok Orcbane led aggressive Razormane assaults on Horde supply lines in the southern Barrens. He emerged from Razorfen Kraul with his lieutenants Nak and Kuz. After betraying Mangletooth and leaving him captive at Camp Taurajo, Lok became known to orcish defenders for ruthless raids they struggled to contain. Mangletooth directs Horde champions to Lok's camp, where claiming Lok's skull avenges the captive and strikes at the leadership driving the Razormane offensive.

sections.title: Proof for the Crossroads
sections.body: Mangletooth demands the skulls of all three conspirators for his vengeance, then sends Lok's skull north to Thork at the Crossroads. Thork and the Horde command suspected another quilboar led the raids. Lok's skull came as a grim surprise, and proved that the threat to the Barrens' central trade routes had been cut down.

faq.answer: Lok Orcbane was a formidable Razormane warrior who emerged from Razorfen Kraul to lead quilboar raiding parties across the southern Barrens. He hated orcs and led aggressive assaults on Horde caravans and outposts with his trusted allies Nak and Kuz.

faq.q: Why does Mangletooth want Lok's Skull?
faq.answer: Lok Orcbane and his companions betrayed Mangletooth and left him to be captured and caged by the tauren at Camp Taurajo. Certain his own death is near, Mangletooth seeks vengeance on those who abandoned him and directs Horde adventurers to kill his former comrades.

faq.q: Why is the skull brought to Thork at the Crossroads?
faq.answer: Thork oversees the Crossroads' defense and works to protect Horde supply routes from quilboar attacks. Lok's Skull proves to the orc commander that the leader of the southern raids has been slain, bringing safety to travelers in the region.
Nak and Kuz led raids alongside Lok Orcbane in the southern Barrens. Mangletooth says one was a spellcaster and the other a tracker, backing Lok's strength as a warrior in raids against the Horde.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, taking Lok Orcbane's skull breaks the southern quilboar leadership that harasses supply caravans between Camp Taurajo and the Crossroads.
As an orc, displaying the severed head of a quilboar chieftain named 'Orcbane' brings deep satisfaction and safety to those defending the Barrens.
